# `Q-5-14` — `project.render` Pattern Outside the Project Root

> A `project.render` pattern's `..` segments climb above the
> project root, so it matches nothing.

## What this means

`project.render` patterns resolve against the project root — the
directory holding `_quarto.yml`. A pattern may contain `..`
segments, but the result must stay inside the project. A pattern
like `../shared/*.qmd` refers to files the project does not
contain, so it matches nothing and this warning fires.

## Why this happens

Usually a pattern copied from a sibling project, or written when
`_quarto.yml` lived one directory deeper.

## How to fix

Adjust the pattern so it stays within the project directory. A
project renders only its own files; to render documents that live
outside the project tree, either move them into the project or
give them a project of their own.

Note that a leading `/` is not a filesystem path — it anchors the
pattern at the project root, which is where patterns resolve
anyway:

```yaml
project:
  render:
    - "/index.qmd"   # the project's own index.qmd
```
